dish_identity: the supplied raw lamb skewers - thin bamboo skewers threading alternating 3 cm cubes of deep-red lean lamb and white marbled fat, seven to eight pieces per skewer - grilled directly over glowing charcoal until the fat renders glossy and every surface turns an even sauce-brown with light char at a few edges, cooked through with no pink centre, never blackened, dried out, or confused with paler pork or coarser dark-grained beef
